upstream.scope: Named, non-deprecated public methods in the published TypeScript declarations; constructors and serialization protocol symbols are excluded.

notes: Frontend support describes the observable local provider contract and is independent of backend capability classifications.
Cloud control-plane inputs with no local semantic effect are not applicable; requested observable behavior that Localbox cannot honor is unsupported.
Snapshots, forks, hosted sessions, users and groups, interactive terminals, drive mounts, custom network policies, and post-create resource updates remain explicit unsupported differences.
Vercel runtime and image aliases resolve through the shared schema-v1 artifact mapping contract without changing public exports, concrete OCI references, metadata, or default Docker composition.

entries.name: Sandbox.list
entries.rationale: Local pagination and Docker metadata are available; Vercel credentials and hosted control-plane filters have no local effect.

entries.name: Sandbox.create
entries.rationale: Localbox maps supported resources, sources, tags, placement metadata, callbacks, and allow-all or deny-all networking; drive mounts, snapshot retention, and custom policies are rejected before client allocation.

entries.name: Sandbox.get
entries.rationale: Named local sandbox records replace Vercel control-plane sandbox lookup.

entries.name: Sandbox.getOrCreate
entries.rationale: Creation and resume callbacks are preserved for the local lifecycle without Vercel control-plane state.

entries.name: Sandbox.fork
entries.rationale: Localbox has no portable sandbox clone or snapshot source that can preserve fork behavior.

entries.name: sandbox.getCommand
entries.rationale: Command handles are process-local and cannot be reconstructed by a hosted command identifier.

entries.name: sandbox.runCommand
entries.rationale: Direct argv, detached execution, streams, signals, and aborts are supported; sudo and timeoutMs are not.

entries.name: sandbox.openInteractive
entries.rationale: The current runtime exposes exec commands but no interactive terminal or PTY contract.

entries.name: sandbox.downloadFile
entries.rationale: The frontend composes bounded SandboxClient reads with an explicit host-file write.

entries.name: sandbox.writeFiles
entries.rationale: The frontend composes the batch from bounded SandboxClient file writes.

entries.name: sandbox.domain
entries.rationale: The returned endpoint is a loopback HTTP URL rather than a public Vercel domain.

entries.name: sandbox.currentSession
entries.rationale: Local execution has no Vercel session identity or hosted session lifecycle.

entries.name: sandbox.stop
entries.rationale: Localbox stops the sandbox but does not return Vercel CPU, network, or snapshot metadata.

entries.name: sandbox.update
entries.rationale: Localbox cannot honor hosted resource, network, timeout, environment, or isolation updates after sandbox creation.

entries.name: sandbox.listSessions
entries.rationale: Local execution does not create hosted sessions that can be listed.

entries.name: sandbox.listSnapshots
entries.rationale: The current runtime cannot create or enumerate portable snapshots.

entries.name: sandbox.snapshot
entries.rationale: No current backend provides the portable snapshot behavior required by this API.

entries.name: sandbox.getDefaultUser
entries.rationale: The runtime does not expose hosted user-management state through SandboxClient.

entries.name: sandbox.createUser
entries.rationale: The runtime does not expose hosted user creation through SandboxClient.

entries.name: sandbox.asUser
entries.rationale: Arbitrary provider user switching is not a supported SandboxClient operation.

entries.name: sandbox.createGroup
entries.rationale: The runtime does not expose hosted group creation through SandboxClient.

entries.name: sandbox.addUserToGroup
entries.rationale: The runtime does not expose hosted group membership changes through SandboxClient.

entries.name: sandbox.removeUserFromGroup
entries.rationale: The runtime does not expose hosted group membership changes through SandboxClient.

entries.name: command.logs
entries.rationale: The frontend presents an async iterator over bounded SandboxClient output pages.

entries.name: command.output
entries.rationale: The frontend collects ordered SandboxClient output pages until completion.

entries.name: command.stdout
entries.rationale: The frontend filters collected output pages to stdout.

entries.name: command.stderr
entries.rationale: The frontend filters collected output pages to stderr.
